ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous aimerions réserver une table pour quatre personnes samedi soir.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We would like to book a table for four on Saturday evening.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Gostaríamos de reservar uma mesa para quatro pessoas no sábado à noite.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que vous pourriez nous apporter la carte des desserts, s'il vous plaît ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring us the dessert menu, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você poderia nos trazer o cardápio de sobremesas, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: La dernière fois, j'ai commandé le poisson et c'était délicieux.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Last time, I ordered the fish and it was delicious.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Da última vez, pedi o peixe e estava delicioso.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je prendrais bien un café, mais il est déjà un peu tard.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd happily have a coffee, but it's already a bit late.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu tomaria um café, mas já está um pouco tarde.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le serveur nous a dit que la cuisine fermait à vingt-deux heures.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The waiter told us that the kitchen closed at ten p.m.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O garçom nos disse que a cozinha fechava às vinte e duas horas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Qu'est-ce que vous nous conseilleriez comme vin avec le canard ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: What wine would you recommend with the duck?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Que vinho você nos recomendaria com o pato?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je suis végétarien, est-ce que vous avez des plats sans viande ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm vegetarian, do you have any dishes without meat?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Sou vegetariano, vocês têm pratos sem carne?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Quand j'étais étudiant, je venais dans ce café tous les matins.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: When I was a student, I came to this café every morning.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Quando eu era estudante, vinha a este café todas as manhãs.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On va partager une entrée et ensuite chacun prendra un plat.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We'll share a starter and then each of us will have a main course.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vamos dividir uma entrada e depois cada um vai pedir um prato.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Excusez-moi, je crois qu'il y a une erreur dans l'addition.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, I think there's a mistake in the bill.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com licença, acho que tem um erro na conta.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Marie a laissé un gros pourboire parce que le service était excellent.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Marie left a big tip because the service was excellent.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Marie deixou uma boa gorjeta porque o atendimento foi excelente.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Si j'avais plus faim, je prendrais aussi le fromage.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: If I were hungrier, I would have the cheese too.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Se eu estivesse com mais fome, pediria também o queijo.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous avons attendu presque une heure avant d'être servis.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We waited almost an hour before being served.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Esperamos quase uma hora antes de sermos servidos.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce qu'il serait possible d'avoir une table en terrasse ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would it be possible to have a table outside on the terrace?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Seria possível ter uma mesa na área externa?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je voudrais mon steak bien cuit, avec des frites au lieu de la salade.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd like my steak well done, with fries instead of the salad.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu queria meu bife bem passado, com batata frita no lugar da salada.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce restaurant était bien meilleur avant le changement de propriétaire.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: This restaurant was much better before the change of owner.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Este restaurante era bem melhor antes da troca de dono.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous accepteriez la carte bancaire pour un montant de huit euros ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would you accept a card for an amount of eight euros?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês aceitariam cartão para um valor de oito euros?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Paul a renversé son verre de vin rouge sur la nappe blanche.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Paul spilled his glass of red wine on the white tablecloth.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O Paul derrubou a taça de vinho tinto na toalha branca.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Demain midi, on essaiera la nouvelle crêperie près de la gare.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Tomorrow at lunchtime, we'll try the new crêperie near the station.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Amanhã no almoço, vamos experimentar a nova creperia perto da estação.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pourriez-vous nous apporter une carafe d'eau et un peu de pain ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring us a jug of water and some bread?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você poderia nos trazer uma jarra de água e um pouco de pão?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le plat du jour coûte quatorze euros, dessert et café compris.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The dish of the day costs fourteen euros, dessert and coffee included.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O prato do dia custa catorze euros, com sobremesa e café incluídos.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je suis allergique aux noix, est-ce que ce gâteau en contient ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm allergic to nuts, does this cake contain any?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Sou alérgico a nozes, este bolo contém alguma?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On pourrait payer séparément, chacun ce qu'il a pris ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could we pay separately, each for what we had?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Podemos pagar separado, cada um o que consumiu?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Mes parents ont fêté leur anniversaire de mariage dans ce bistrot.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: My parents celebrated their wedding anniversary in this bistro.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Meus pais comemoraram o aniversário de casamento neste bistrô.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: À mon avis, les prix sont un peu trop élevés pour la qualité.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: In my opinion, the prices are a bit too high for the quality.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Na minha opinião, os preços são um pouco altos demais para a qualidade.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je reprendrais volontiers un deuxième chocolat chaud avec de la chantilly.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd gladly have a second hot chocolate with whipped cream.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu tomaria com prazer um segundo chocolate quente com chantilly.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le chef préparait toujours une soupe maison quand il faisait froid.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The chef always made a homemade soup when it was cold.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O chef sempre preparava uma sopa caseira quando fazia frio.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que vous faites aussi des plats à emporter le dimanche ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you also do takeaway dishes on Sundays?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês também fazem pratos para viagem aos domingos?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous reviendrons sûrement, c'était vraiment un excellent repas.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We'll definitely come back, it was a really excellent meal.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com certeza vamos voltar, foi realmente uma refeição excelente.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Sophie a demandé si elle pouvait remplacer les champignons par des légumes.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Sophie asked if she could swap the mushrooms for vegetables.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Sophie perguntou se podia trocar os cogumelos por legumes.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il n'y avait plus de tarte aux pommes, alors j'ai pris une mousse.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: There was no apple tart left, so I had a mousse.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Não tinha mais torta de maçã, então pedi uma mousse.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je préférerais m'asseoir loin de la porte, il fait un peu froid.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd rather sit away from the door, it's a bit cold.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu preferiria me sentar longe da porta, está um pouco frio.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous avez choisi, ou vous voulez encore quelques minutes ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Have you decided, or would you like a few more minutes?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês já escolheram ou querem mais alguns minutos?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On m'a servi une salade alors que j'avais commandé une omelette.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: They served me a salad when I had ordered an omelette.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Me serviram uma salada, sendo que eu tinha pedido uma omelete.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce soir, je vais inviter Lucas au restaurant pour le remercier.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Tonight, I'm going to take Lucas out to a restaurant to thank him.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Hoje à noite, vou convidar o Lucas para jantar fora para agradecer a ele.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le café était tellement fort que je n'ai pas réussi à dormir.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The coffee was so strong that I couldn't sleep.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O café estava tão forte que não consegui dormir.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que le menu enfant comprend une boisson et une glace ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Does the children's menu include a drink and an ice cream?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O menu infantil inclui uma bebida e um sorvete?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous aurions dû réserver, toutes les tables sont déjà prises.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We should have booked, all the tables are already taken.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Devíamos ter reservado, todas as mesas já estão ocupadas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je trouve que la cuisine de ce restaurant manque un peu de sel.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I find that the food at this restaurant lacks a bit of salt.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Acho que a comida deste restaurante está com pouco sal.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Quand vous aurez une minute, pourriez-vous nous apporter l'addition ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: When you have a minute, could you bring us the bill?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Quando tiver um minuto, você poderia nos trazer a conta?

travel and directions.text: Pourriez-vous m'expliquer comment aller à la gare depuis ici ?
travel and directions.en: Could you explain how to get to the station from here?
travel and directions.pt: Você poderia me explicar como chegar à estação daqui?

travel and directions.text: Nous avons raté notre train et nous avons dû attendre deux heures.
travel and directions.en: We missed our train and had to wait two hours.
travel and directions.pt: Perdemos o trem e tivemos que esperar duas horas.

travel and directions.text: L'été prochain, nous partirons en Bretagne pendant trois semaines.
travel and directions.en: Next summer, we'll go to Brittany for three weeks.
travel and directions.pt: No próximo verão, vamos para a Bretanha por três semanas.

travel and directions.text: Si vous tournez à gauche au feu, vous verrez la poste.
travel and directions.en: If you turn left at the lights, you'll see the post office.
travel and directions.pt: Se você virar à esquerda no semáforo, vai ver os correios.

travel and directions.text: Je me suis perdu dans le métro, je ne connaissais pas la ligne.
travel and directions.en: I got lost in the metro, I didn't know the line.
travel and directions.pt: Eu me perdi no metrô, não conhecia a linha.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce que ce bus s'arrête près du musée d'Orsay ?
travel and directions.en: Does this bus stop near the Musée d'Orsay?
travel and directions.pt: Este ônibus para perto do Museu d'Orsay?

travel and directions.text: Quand j'étais petit, on allait chaque année chez mes grands-parents à Lyon.
travel and directions.en: When I was little, we went to my grandparents' in Lyon every year.
travel and directions.pt: Quando eu era pequeno, a gente ia todo ano à casa dos meus avós em Lyon.

travel and directions.text: Il faut environ vingt minutes à pied pour rejoindre le centre-ville.
travel and directions.en: It takes about twenty minutes on foot to get to the town centre.
travel and directions.pt: Leva cerca de vinte minutos a pé para chegar ao centro da cidade.

travel and directions.text: J'aimerais louer une voiture pour visiter les villages de Provence.
travel and directions.en: I'd like to rent a car to visit the villages of Provence.
travel and directions.pt: Eu gostaria de alugar um carro para visitar os vilarejos da Provença.

travel and directions.text: Le vol pour Lisbonne a été annulé à cause de la grève.
travel and directions.en: The flight to Lisbon was cancelled because of the strike.
travel and directions.pt: O voo para Lisboa foi cancelado por causa da greve.

travel and directions.text: Continuez tout droit jusqu'au rond-point, puis prenez la deuxième sortie.
travel and directions.en: Go straight on to the roundabout, then take the second exit.
travel and directions.pt: Siga em frente até a rotatória e depois pegue a segunda saída.

travel and directions.text: Claire voyagerait plus souvent si les billets d'avion étaient moins chers.
travel and directions.en: Claire would travel more often if plane tickets were cheaper.
travel and directions.pt: A Claire viajaria com mais frequência se as passagens de avião fossem mais baratas.

travel and directions.text: Où est-ce que je peux acheter un ticket pour le tramway ?
travel and directions.en: Where can I buy a ticket for the tram?
travel and directions.pt: Onde posso comprar um bilhete para o bonde?

travel and directions.text: Nous avons dormi dans une petite auberge au bord du lac.
travel and directions.en: We slept in a small inn on the shore of the lake.
travel and directions.pt: Dormimos numa pequena pousada à beira do lago.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce que vous savez s'il y a une pharmacie dans le quartier ?
travel and directions.en: Do you know if there's a pharmacy in the area?
travel and directions.pt: Você sabe se tem uma farmácia no bairro?

travel and directions.text: Mon passeport expire bientôt, je dois le renouveler avant les vacances.
travel and directions.en: My passport expires soon, I have to renew it before the holidays.
travel and directions.pt: Meu passaporte vence logo, preciso renová-lo antes das férias.

travel and directions.text: Je crois que nous sommes allés trop loin, il fallait tourner avant.
travel and directions.en: I think we've gone too far, we should have turned earlier.
travel and directions.pt: Acho que fomos longe demais, era para ter virado antes.

travel and directions.text: Le train de 8 h 15 partira avec dix minutes de retard.
travel and directions.en: The 8:15 train will leave ten minutes late.
travel and directions.pt: O trem das 8h15 vai partir com dez minutos de atraso.

travel and directions.text: À ton avis, vaut-il mieux prendre le train ou la voiture ?
travel and directions.en: In your opinion, is it better to take the train or the car?
travel and directions.pt: Na sua opinião, é melhor ir de trem ou de carro?

travel and directions.text: Thomas a oublié sa valise dans le taxi en arrivant à l'hôtel.
travel and directions.en: Thomas left his suitcase in the taxi when he arrived at the hotel.
travel and directions.pt: O Thomas esqueceu a mala no táxi ao chegar ao hotel.

travel and directions.text: La plage se trouve à cinq minutes de la gare routière.
travel and directions.en: The beach is five minutes from the bus station.
travel and directions.pt: A praia fica a cinco minutos da rodoviária.

travel and directions.text: On prendra le ferry pour aller en Corse au mois de juin.
travel and directions.en: We'll take the ferry to go to Corsica in June.
travel and directions.pt: Vamos pegar a balsa para ir à Córsega em junho.

travel and directions.text: Excusez-moi, est-ce que je suis bien sur la route de Nantes ?
travel and directions.en: Excuse me, am I on the right road for Nantes?
travel and directions.pt: Com licença, estou mesmo na estrada para Nantes?

travel and directions.text: Il pleuvait tellement que nous sommes restés à l'hôtel toute la journée.
travel and directions.en: It was raining so much that we stayed at the hotel all day.
travel and directions.pt: Chovia tanto que ficamos no hotel o dia inteiro.

travel and directions.text: Je voudrais un aller-retour pour Bordeaux, en deuxième classe, s'il vous plaît.
travel and directions.en: I'd like a return ticket to Bordeaux, second class, please.
travel and directions.pt: Eu queria uma passagem de ida e volta para Bordeaux, na segunda classe, por favor.

travel and directions.text: Le guide nous a montré les plus beaux monuments de la vieille ville.
travel and directions.en: The guide showed us the finest monuments in the old town.
travel and directions.pt: O guia nos mostrou os monumentos mais bonitos da cidade velha.

travel and directions.text: Si j'avais le temps, je ferais le tour de l'Europe en train.
travel and directions.en: If I had the time, I would travel around Europe by train.
travel and directions.pt: Se eu tivesse tempo, daria a volta pela Europa de trem.

travel and directions.text: Vous devez composter votre billet avant de monter dans le train.
travel and directions.en: You must validate your ticket before getting on the train.
travel and directions.pt: Você precisa validar o bilhete antes de entrar no trem.

travel and directions.text: Nous allons traverser le pont et chercher un endroit pour déjeuner.
travel and directions.en: We're going to cross the bridge and look for somewhere to have lunch.
travel and directions.pt: Vamos atravessar a ponte e procurar um lugar para almoçar.

travel and directions.text: L'hôtel était plus loin du centre que ce que nous pensions.
travel and directions.en: The hotel was further from the centre than we thought.
travel and directions.pt: O hotel ficava mais longe do centro do que pensávamos.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce que tu pourrais regarder sur la carte où se trouve la cathédrale ?
travel and directions.en: Could you look on the map to see where the cathedral is?
travel and directions.pt: Você poderia olhar no mapa onde fica a catedral?

travel and directions.text: Julie a passé six mois au Canada pour améliorer son anglais.
travel and directions.en: Julie spent six months in Canada to improve her English.
travel and directions.pt: A Julie passou seis meses no Canadá para melhorar o inglês.

travel and directions.text: À la douane, on nous a demandé d'ouvrir toutes nos valises.
travel and directions.en: At customs, they asked us to open all our suitcases.
travel and directions.pt: Na alfândega, pediram para abrirmos todas as nossas malas.

travel and directions.text: Prenez la ligne quatre et descendez à la troisième station.
travel and directions.en: Take line four and get off at the third stop.
travel and directions.pt: Pegue a linha quatro e desça na terceira estação.

travel and directions.text: Je préférerais partir tôt le matin pour éviter les embouteillages.
travel and directions.en: I'd rather leave early in the morning to avoid the traffic jams.
travel and directions.pt: Eu preferiria sair cedo de manhã para evitar os engarrafamentos.

travel and directions.text: Notre chambre devait donner sur la mer, mais elle donnait sur le parking.
travel and directions.en: Our room was supposed to face the sea, but it looked onto the car park.
travel and directions.pt: Nosso quarto deveria ter vista para o mar, mas dava para o estacionamento.

travel and directions.text: Le musée est fermé le lundi, il faudra revenir mardi.
travel and directions.en: The museum is closed on Mondays, we'll have to come back on Tuesday.
travel and directions.pt: O museu fecha às segundas, vamos ter que voltar na terça.

travel and directions.text: Combien de temps faut-il pour aller à l'aéroport en navette ?
travel and directions.en: How long does it take to get to the airport by shuttle?
travel and directions.pt: Quanto tempo leva para ir ao aeroporto de transfer?

travel and directions.text: Mes amis m'ont recommandé un petit restaurant près du port.
travel and directions.en: My friends recommended a little restaurant near the harbour.
travel and directions.pt: Meus amigos me recomendaram um restaurantezinho perto do porto.

travel and directions.text: La prochaine fois, je réserverai mon billet au moins un mois à l'avance.
travel and directions.en: Next time, I'll book my ticket at least a month in advance.
travel and directions.pt: Da próxima vez, vou reservar minha passagem com pelo menos um mês de antecedência.

shopping.text: Est-ce que vous auriez cette chemise dans une taille plus grande ?
shopping.en: Would you have this shirt in a bigger size?
shopping.pt: Vocês teriam esta camisa num tamanho maior?

shopping.text: J'ai acheté ces chaussures en solde, elles étaient à moitié prix.
shopping.en: I bought these shoes in the sales, they were half price.
shopping.pt: Comprei estes sapatos na liquidação, estavam pela metade do preço.

shopping.text: Je cherche un cadeau pour ma mère, vous auriez une idée ?
shopping.en: I'm looking for a present for my mother, do you have any ideas?
shopping.pt: Estou procurando um presente para minha mãe, você teria alguma ideia?

shopping.text: Ce pull me plaît beaucoup, mais il est un peu trop cher.
shopping.en: I really like this jumper, but it's a bit too expensive.
shopping.pt: Gosto muito deste suéter, mas está um pouco caro demais.

shopping.text: Samedi, nous irons au marché pour acheter des fruits et des légumes.
shopping.en: On Saturday, we'll go to the market to buy fruit and vegetables.
shopping.pt: No sábado, vamos à feira comprar frutas e legumes.

shopping.text: Est-ce que je pourrais essayer cette veste dans la cabine du fond ?
shopping.en: Could I try on this jacket in the changing room at the back?
shopping.pt: Eu poderia experimentar esta jaqueta no provador lá do fundo?

shopping.text: Je voudrais rendre ce pantalon, il ne me va pas du tout.
shopping.en: I'd like to return these trousers, they don't fit me at all.
shopping.pt: Eu queria devolver esta calça, ela não ficou nada bem em mim.

shopping.text: Avant, je faisais toutes mes courses au supermarché près de chez moi.
shopping.en: I used to do all my shopping at the supermarket near my home.
shopping.pt: Antes, eu fazia todas as compras no supermercado perto de casa.

shopping.text: Vous pouvez garder le ticket de caisse au cas où il faudrait l'échanger.
shopping.en: You can keep the receipt in case you need to exchange it.
shopping.pt: Você pode guardar o cupom fiscal caso precise trocar.

shopping.text: Léa a dépensé tout son salaire en vêtements le mois dernier.
shopping.en: Léa spent her whole salary on clothes last month.
shopping.pt: A Léa gastou o salário inteiro em roupas no mês passado.

shopping.text: Je préfère acheter dans les petites boutiques plutôt que sur internet.
shopping.en: I prefer buying in small shops rather than online.
shopping.pt: Prefiro comprar em lojinhas do que pela internet.

shopping.text: Est-ce que la livraison est gratuite à partir de cinquante euros ?
shopping.en: Is delivery free on orders over fifty euros?
shopping.pt: A entrega é grátis a partir de cinquenta euros?

shopping.text: Si cette robe existait en bleu, je l'achèterais tout de suite.
shopping.en: If this dress came in blue, I'd buy it straight away.
shopping.pt: Se este vestido existisse em azul, eu compraria na hora.

shopping.text: La vendeuse m'a conseillé une crème pour les peaux sensibles.
shopping.en: The saleswoman recommended a cream for sensitive skin.
shopping.pt: A vendedora me recomendou um creme para pele sensível.

shopping.text: Il ne reste plus de pain, tu pourrais passer à la boulangerie ?
shopping.en: There's no bread left, could you stop by the bakery?
shopping.pt: Acabou o pão, você poderia passar na padaria?

shopping.text: On m'a remboursé parce que l'appareil ne fonctionnait pas.
shopping.en: They gave me a refund because the device didn't work.
shopping.pt: Me reembolsaram porque o aparelho não funcionava.

shopping.text: Ces tomates viennent directement d'une ferme à côté de Toulouse.
shopping.en: These tomatoes come straight from a farm near Toulouse.
shopping.pt: Estes tomates vêm direto de uma fazenda perto de Toulouse.

shopping.text: Je vais comparer les prix avant d'acheter un nouvel ordinateur.
shopping.en: I'm going to compare prices before buying a new computer.
shopping.pt: Vou comparar os preços antes de comprar um computador novo.

shopping.text: Vous allez payer par carte ou en espèces, madame ?
shopping.en: Will you be paying by card or in cash, madam?
shopping.pt: A senhora vai pagar no cartão ou em dinheiro?

shopping.text: Le magasin ouvrira ses portes à dix heures pendant les fêtes.
shopping.en: The shop will open its doors at ten o'clock during the holidays.
shopping.pt: A loja vai abrir às dez horas durante as festas de fim de ano.

shopping.text: Mon frère a trouvé un vélo d'occasion en très bon état.
shopping.en: My brother found a second-hand bike in very good condition.
shopping.pt: Meu irmão achou uma bicicleta usada em ótimo estado.

shopping.text: Je trouve que les centres commerciaux sont trop bruyants le samedi.
shopping.en: I find shopping centres too noisy on Saturdays.
shopping.pt: Acho que os shoppings são barulhentos demais aos sábados.

shopping.text: Est-ce que vous faites des paquets cadeaux pour les anniversaires ?
shopping.en: Do you do gift wrapping for birthdays?
shopping.pt: Vocês fazem embrulho de presente para aniversários?

shopping.text: Il y avait tellement de monde que nous sommes repartis sans rien acheter.
shopping.en: There were so many people that we left without buying anything.
shopping.pt: Tinha tanta gente que fomos embora sem comprar nada.

shopping.text: J'aurais aimé acheter ce manteau, mais il n'y avait plus ma taille.
shopping.en: I would have liked to buy this coat, but my size was gone.
shopping.pt: Eu teria gostado de comprar este casaco, mas não tinha mais o meu tamanho.

shopping.text: Combien coûtent ces pommes au kilo, s'il vous plaît ?
shopping.en: How much are these apples per kilo, please?
shopping.pt: Quanto custa o quilo destas maçãs, por favor?

shopping.text: Nous devrions faire une liste pour ne rien oublier au supermarché.
shopping.en: We should make a list so we don't forget anything at the supermarket.
shopping.pt: Deveríamos fazer uma lista para não esquecer nada no supermercado.

shopping.text: La qualité de ces sacs est meilleure que celle des sacs bon marché.
shopping.en: The quality of these bags is better than that of cheap bags.
shopping.pt: A qualidade destas bolsas é melhor que a das bolsas baratas.

shopping.text: Quand je serai à Paris, j'achèterai des macarons pour mes collègues.
shopping.en: When I'm in Paris, I'll buy some macarons for my colleagues.
shopping.pt: Quando eu estiver em Paris, vou comprar macarons para meus colegas.

shopping.text: Ce téléphone était en promotion, alors je n'ai pas hésité.
shopping.en: This phone was on special offer, so I didn't hesitate.
shopping.pt: Este celular estava em promoção, então não hesitei.

shopping.text: Désolé, nous n'acceptons pas les chèques depuis le mois de janvier.
shopping.en: Sorry, we haven't accepted cheques since January.
shopping.pt: Desculpe, não aceitamos cheques desde janeiro.

shopping.text: Antoine cherchait un costume pour le mariage de sa sœur.
shopping.en: Antoine was looking for a suit for his sister's wedding.
shopping.pt: O Antoine procurava um terno para o casamento da irmã.

shopping.text: Pourriez-vous me dire où se trouve le rayon des produits laitiers ?
shopping.en: Could you tell me where the dairy aisle is?
shopping.pt: Você poderia me dizer onde fica a seção de laticínios?

shopping.text: J'ai l'impression que tout coûte plus cher que l'année dernière.
shopping.en: I get the feeling that everything costs more than last year.
shopping.pt: Tenho a impressão de que tudo está mais caro que no ano passado.

shopping.text: Ce fromage serait parfait pour le repas de dimanche avec les amis.
shopping.en: This cheese would be perfect for Sunday's meal with friends.
shopping.pt: Este queijo seria perfeito para o almoço de domingo com os amigos.

shopping.text: Elle a commandé un livre en ligne, mais il n'est jamais arrivé.
shopping.en: She ordered a book online, but it never arrived.
shopping.pt: Ela encomendou um livro pela internet, mas ele nunca chegou.

shopping.text: Vous pourriez me faire une petite réduction si j'en prends trois ?
shopping.en: Could you give me a small discount if I take three?
shopping.pt: Você poderia me dar um descontinho se eu levar três?

shopping.text: Le samedi matin, mon père allait toujours chez le même boucher.
shopping.en: On Saturday mornings, my father always went to the same butcher.
shopping.pt: Aos sábados de manhã, meu pai sempre ia ao mesmo açougue.

shopping.text: Je vais attendre les soldes pour m'acheter un nouveau canapé.
shopping.en: I'm going to wait for the sales to buy myself a new sofa.
shopping.pt: Vou esperar a liquidação para comprar um sofá novo.

shopping.text: Est-ce que cette lampe marche avec des piles ou sur secteur ?
shopping.en: Does this lamp run on batteries or on mains power?
shopping.pt: Esta luminária funciona com pilha ou na tomada?

work and meetings.text: La réunion de demain a été repoussée à quinze heures.
work and meetings.en: Tomorrow's meeting has been pushed back to three p.m.
work and meetings.pt: A reunião de amanhã foi adiada para as quinze horas.

work and meetings.text: Je pense que nous devrions présenter le projet au client la semaine prochaine.
work and meetings.en: I think we should present the project to the client next week.
work and meetings.pt: Acho que deveríamos apresentar o projeto ao cliente na semana que vem.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que tu pourrais m'envoyer le compte rendu de la réunion ?
work and meetings.en: Could you send me the minutes of the meeting?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia me mandar a ata da reunião?

work and meetings.text: Mon ancien patron était très exigeant, mais il était toujours juste.
work and meetings.en: My former boss was very demanding, but he was always fair.
work and meetings.pt: Meu antigo chefe era muito exigente, mas sempre foi justo.

work and meetings.text: Nous avons travaillé tard hier soir pour terminer le rapport.
work and meetings.en: We worked late last night to finish the report.
work and meetings.pt: Trabalhamos até tarde ontem à noite para terminar o relatório.

work and meetings.text: Si j'avais le choix, je travaillerais de chez moi deux jours par semaine.
work and meetings.en: If I had the choice, I'd work from home two days a week.
work and meetings.pt: Se eu pudesse escolher, trabalharia de casa dois dias por semana.

work and meetings.text: Camille commencera son nouveau poste au service marketing en septembre.
work and meetings.en: Camille will start her new job in the marketing department in September.
work and meetings.pt: A Camille vai começar no novo cargo no departamento de marketing em setembro.

work and meetings.text: À mon avis, cette réunion aurait pu être remplacée par un simple courriel.
work and meetings.en: In my opinion, this meeting could have been replaced by a simple email.
work and meetings.pt: Na minha opinião, essa reunião poderia ter sido substituída por um simples e-mail.

work and meetings.text: Le directeur a annoncé que l'entreprise allait ouvrir un bureau à Marseille.
work and meetings.en: The director announced that the company was going to open an office in Marseille.
work and meetings.pt: O diretor anunciou que a empresa ia abrir um escritório em Marselha.

work and meetings.text: Pourriez-vous préparer quelques diapositives pour la présentation de jeudi ?
work and meetings.en: Could you prepare a few slides for Thursday's presentation?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia preparar alguns slides para a apresentação de quinta?

work and meetings.text: Je n'ai pas eu le temps de lire tous les documents avant la réunion.
work and meetings.en: I didn't have time to read all the documents before the meeting.
work and meetings.pt: Não tive tempo de ler todos os documentos antes da reunião.

work and meetings.text: On fera le point sur les ventes à la fin du mois.
work and meetings.en: We'll review the sales at the end of the month.
work and meetings.pt: Vamos fazer um balanço das vendas no fim do mês.

work and meetings.text: Quand j'ai commencé ici, l'équipe ne comptait que cinq personnes.
work and meetings.en: When I started here, the team had only five people.
work and meetings.pt: Quando comecei aqui, a equipe tinha só cinco pessoas.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que quelqu'un a des questions avant que nous passions au point suivant ?
work and meetings.en: Does anyone have any questions before we move on to the next item?
work and meetings.pt: Alguém tem perguntas antes de passarmos para o próximo item?

work and meetings.text: J'aimerais demander une augmentation, mais je ne sais pas comment m'y prendre.
work and meetings.en: I'd like to ask for a raise, but I don't know how to go about it.
work and meetings.pt: Eu gostaria de pedir um aumento, mas não sei como fazer isso.

work and meetings.text: Nicolas est en congé cette semaine, il reviendra lundi prochain.
work and meetings.en: Nicolas is on leave this week, he'll be back next Monday.
work and meetings.pt: O Nicolas está de folga esta semana, ele volta na próxima segunda.

work and meetings.text: Les résultats du trimestre sont meilleurs que ce que nous attendions.
work and meetings.en: The quarter's results are better than we expected.
work and meetings.pt: Os resultados do trimestre são melhores do que esperávamos.

work and meetings.text: Je vais prendre des notes pendant que vous présentez le budget.
work and meetings.en: I'll take notes while you present the budget.
work and meetings.pt: Vou fazer anotações enquanto você apresenta o orçamento.

work and meetings.text: Il faudrait fixer une date limite pour la remise des propositions.
work and meetings.en: We should set a deadline for submitting the proposals.
work and meetings.pt: Seria bom definir um prazo para a entrega das propostas.

work and meetings.text: Mon collègue m'a aidé à résoudre un problème avec le logiciel.
work and meetings.en: My colleague helped me solve a problem with the software.
work and meetings.pt: Meu colega me ajudou a resolver um problema com o software.

work and meetings.text: Nous pourrions organiser une visioconférence avec l'équipe de Montréal.
work and meetings.en: We could set up a video call with the Montreal team.
work and meetings.pt: Poderíamos organizar uma videoconferência com a equipe de Montreal.

work and meetings.text: L'entretien d'embauche s'est bien passé, j'attends leur réponse.
work and meetings.en: The job interview went well, I'm waiting for their answer.
work and meetings.pt: A entrevista de emprego foi bem, estou esperando a resposta deles.

work and meetings.text: Je trouve qu'on a trop de réunions et pas assez de temps.
work and meetings.en: I think we have too many meetings and not enough time.
work and meetings.pt: Acho que temos reuniões demais e tempo de menos.

work and meetings.text: La photocopieuse était encore en panne quand je suis arrivé ce matin.
work and meetings.en: The photocopier was broken again when I arrived this morning.
work and meetings.pt: A copiadora estava quebrada de novo quando cheguei hoje de manhã.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que vous seriez disponible mardi pour discuter du contrat ?
work and meetings.en: Would you be available on Tuesday to discuss the contract?
work and meetings.pt: Você estaria disponível na terça para discutir o contrato?

work and meetings.text: Elle a quitté son emploi pour créer sa propre entreprise.
work and meetings.en: She left her job to start her own business.
work and meetings.pt: Ela largou o emprego para abrir a própria empresa.

work and meetings.text: Je terminerai ce dossier avant de partir en vacances, c'est promis.
work and meetings.en: I'll finish this file before I go on holiday, I promise.
work and meetings.pt: Vou terminar este processo antes de sair de férias, prometo.

work and meetings.text: Le client voudrait recevoir le devis avant vendredi midi.
work and meetings.en: The client would like to receive the quote before Friday noon.
work and meetings.pt: O cliente gostaria de receber o orçamento antes de sexta ao meio-dia.

work and meetings.text: Avant, je prenais le métro, mais maintenant je vais au bureau à vélo.
work and meetings.en: I used to take the metro, but now I cycle to the office.
work and meetings.pt: Antes eu pegava o metrô, mas agora vou ao escritório de bicicleta.

work and meetings.text: Si le projet réussit, nous embaucherons trois nouvelles personnes.
work and meetings.en: If the project succeeds, we'll hire three new people.
work and meetings.pt: Se o projeto der certo, vamos contratar três pessoas novas.

work and meetings.text: Pourriez-vous rappeler à tout le monde que la réunion commence à neuf heures ?
work and meetings.en: Could you remind everyone that the meeting starts at nine?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia lembrar a todos que a reunião começa às nove?

work and meetings.text: Pendant la pause, nous avons parlé des vacances d'été.
work and meetings.en: During the break, we talked about the summer holidays.
work and meetings.pt: Durante o intervalo, falamos sobre as férias de verão.

work and meetings.text: Je ne suis pas d'accord avec cette décision, mais je la respecte.
work and meetings.en: I don't agree with this decision, but I respect it.
work and meetings.pt: Não concordo com essa decisão, mas a respeito.

work and meetings.text: Le stagiaire a fait un excellent travail sur l'analyse des données.
work and meetings.en: The intern did an excellent job on the data analysis.
work and meetings.pt: O estagiário fez um ótimo trabalho na análise dos dados.

work and meetings.text: On devrait peut-être demander l'avis du service juridique.
work and meetings.en: Maybe we should ask the legal department for their opinion.
work and meetings.pt: Talvez devêssemos pedir a opinião do departamento jurídico.

work and meetings.text: Ma cheffe m'a félicité pour la présentation que j'ai faite hier.
work and meetings.en: My boss congratulated me on the presentation I gave yesterday.
work and meetings.pt: Minha chefe me parabenizou pela apresentação que fiz ontem.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que la salle de réunion du troisième étage est libre cet après-midi ?
work and meetings.en: Is the meeting room on the third floor free this afternoon?
work and meetings.pt: A sala de reunião do terceiro andar está livre hoje à tarde?

work and meetings.text: J'étais tellement stressé que j'ai oublié de saluer le client.
work and meetings.en: I was so stressed that I forgot to greet the client.
work and meetings.pt: Eu estava tão estressado que esqueci de cumprimentar o cliente.

work and meetings.text: L'an prochain, l'entreprise va changer de locaux et déménager en banlieue.
work and meetings.en: Next year, the company is going to change premises and move to the suburbs.
work and meetings.pt: No ano que vem, a empresa vai mudar de sede e se transferir para a periferia.

work and meetings.text: Nous aurions besoin de deux semaines supplémentaires pour finir le projet.
work and meetings.en: We would need two more weeks to finish the project.
work and meetings.pt: Precisaríamos de mais duas semanas para terminar o projeto.

family and friends.text: Mes grands-parents habitaient dans une petite maison à la campagne.
family and friends.en: My grandparents lived in a small house in the countryside.
family and friends.pt: Meus avós moravam numa casinha no interior.

family and friends.text: Ce week-end, nous allons fêter les trente ans de ma sœur.
family and friends.en: This weekend, we're going to celebrate my sister's thirtieth birthday.
family and friends.pt: Neste fim de semana, vamos comemorar os trinta anos da minha irmã.

family and friends.text: Mon meilleur ami et moi, nous nous connaissons depuis l'école primaire.
family and friends.en: My best friend and I have known each other since primary school.
family and friends.pt: Eu e meu melhor amigo nos conhecemos desde o ensino fundamental.

family and friends.text: Est-ce que tu viendrais dîner à la maison samedi soir ?
family and friends.en: Would you come over for dinner on Saturday evening?
family and friends.pt: Você viria jantar lá em casa no sábado à noite?

family and friends.text: Quand nous étions enfants, mon frère et moi nous disputions tout le temps.
family and friends.en: When we were children, my brother and I argued all the time.
family and friends.pt: Quando éramos crianças, eu e meu irmão brigávamos o tempo todo.

family and friends.text: Ma cousine s'est mariée l'été dernier dans un château en Normandie.
family and friends.en: My cousin got married last summer in a château in Normandy.
family and friends.pt: Minha prima se casou no verão passado num castelo na Normandia.

family and friends.text: J'aimerais voir mes parents plus souvent, mais ils habitent loin.
family and friends.en: I'd like to see my parents more often, but they live far away.
family and friends.pt: Eu gostaria de ver meus pais com mais frequência, mas eles moram longe.

family and friends.text: Mon oncle raconte toujours les mêmes histoires pendant les repas de famille.
family and friends.en: My uncle always tells the same stories at family meals.
family and friends.pt: Meu tio sempre conta as mesmas histórias nos almoços de família.

family and friends.text: Hugo a eu un petit garçon, il s'appelle Jules.
family and friends.en: Hugo has had a baby boy, his name is Jules.
family and friends.pt: O Hugo teve um menininho, ele se chama Jules.

family and friends.text: Nous inviterons tous nos amis pour pendre la crémaillère.
family and friends.en: We'll invite all our friends to our housewarming party.
family and friends.pt: Vamos convidar todos os nossos amigos para o chá de casa nova.

family and friends.text: Je trouve que ma fille ressemble beaucoup à sa grand-mère.
family and friends.en: I think my daughter looks a lot like her grandmother.
family and friends.pt: Acho que minha filha se parece muito com a avó.

family and friends.text: Si tu avais un problème, tu pourrais toujours compter sur moi.
family and friends.en: If you had a problem, you could always count on me.
family and friends.pt: Se você tivesse um problema, sempre poderia contar comigo.

family and friends.text: Mes parents se sont rencontrés à un bal du 14 Juillet.
family and friends.en: My parents met at a Bastille Day dance.
family and friends.pt: Meus pais se conheceram num baile de 14 de Julho.

family and friends.text: Tous les dimanches, nous déjeunions chez ma tante à Grenoble.
family and friends.en: Every Sunday, we had lunch at my aunt's in Grenoble.
family and friends.pt: Todo domingo, a gente almoçava na casa da minha tia em Grenoble.

family and friends.text: Est-ce que tes enfants vont à la même école que les miens ?
family and friends.en: Do your children go to the same school as mine?
family and friends.pt: Seus filhos estudam na mesma escola que os meus?

family and friends.text: Je me suis réconcilié avec mon ami après une longue dispute.
family and friends.en: I made up with my friend after a long argument.
family and friends.pt: Fiz as pazes com meu amigo depois de uma longa briga.

family and friends.text: Ma belle-mère nous garde les enfants le mercredi après-midi.
family and friends.en: My mother-in-law looks after the children for us on Wednesday afternoons.
family and friends.pt: Minha sogra cuida das crianças para nós nas quartas à tarde.

family and friends.text: On devrait organiser une fête surprise pour le départ de Sarah.
family and friends.en: We should organise a surprise party for Sarah's leaving.
family and friends.pt: A gente devia organizar uma festa surpresa para a despedida da Sarah.

family and friends.text: Mon petit frère vient d'avoir son permis de conduire.
family and friends.en: My little brother has just got his driving licence.
family and friends.pt: Meu irmão mais novo acabou de tirar a carteira de motorista.

family and friends.text: Nous avons passé Noël chez mes beaux-parents en Alsace.
family and friends.en: We spent Christmas at my in-laws' in Alsace.
family and friends.pt: Passamos o Natal na casa dos meus sogros na Alsácia.

family and friends.text: Elle ne s'entendait pas bien avec sa sœur quand elles étaient adolescentes.
family and friends.en: She didn't get on well with her sister when they were teenagers.
family and friends.pt: Ela não se dava bem com a irmã quando eram adolescentes.

family and friends.text: Je vais appeler ma grand-mère, elle se sent un peu seule.
family and friends.en: I'm going to call my grandmother, she feels a bit lonely.
family and friends.pt: Vou ligar para minha avó, ela está se sentindo um pouco sozinha.

family and friends.text: Mes amis d'enfance et moi, nous partons camper chaque année en août.
family and friends.en: My childhood friends and I go camping every year in August.
family and friends.pt: Eu e meus amigos de infância vamos acampar todo ano em agosto.

family and friends.text: Tu crois que ton copain aimerait venir au concert avec nous ?
family and friends.en: Do you think your boyfriend would like to come to the concert with us?
family and friends.pt: Você acha que seu namorado gostaria de ir ao show com a gente?

family and friends.text: Mon père m'a appris à faire du vélo quand j'avais cinq ans.
family and friends.en: My father taught me to ride a bike when I was five.
family and friends.pt: Meu pai me ensinou a andar de bicicleta quando eu tinha cinco anos.

family and friends.text: Ma sœur aînée a deux enfants et attend un troisième pour mars.
family and friends.en: My older sister has two children and is expecting a third in March.
family and friends.pt: Minha irmã mais velha tem dois filhos e está esperando o terceiro para março.

family and friends.text: Je n'ai pas vu Mathilde depuis qu'elle est partie vivre à Berlin.
family and friends.en: I haven't seen Mathilde since she went to live in Berlin.
family and friends.pt: Não vejo a Mathilde desde que ela foi morar em Berlim.

family and friends.text: Mes neveux passeront une semaine chez nous pendant les vacances.
family and friends.en: My nephews will spend a week with us during the holidays.
family and friends.pt: Meus sobrinhos vão passar uma semana conosco durante as férias.

family and friends.text: Qu'est-ce que tu offriras à ton père pour la fête des Pères ?
family and friends.en: What will you give your father for Father's Day?
family and friends.pt: O que você vai dar para o seu pai no Dia dos Pais?

family and friends.text: Mon mari et moi, nous fêterons nos dix ans de mariage en mai.
family and friends.en: My husband and I will celebrate our tenth wedding anniversary in May.
family and friends.pt: Eu e meu marido vamos comemorar dez anos de casamento em maio.

family and friends.text: Autrefois, toute la famille se réunissait chez mes grands-parents à Pâques.
family and friends.en: In the past, the whole family got together at my grandparents' at Easter.
family and friends.pt: Antigamente, a família toda se reunia na casa dos meus avós na Páscoa.

family and friends.text: Une vraie amie, c'est quelqu'un qui te dit la vérité.
family and friends.en: A true friend is someone who tells you the truth.
family and friends.pt: Uma amiga de verdade é alguém que fala a verdade para você.

family and friends.text: Si mes parents vivaient plus près, ils verraient leurs petits-enfants plus souvent.
family and friends.en: If my parents lived closer, they would see their grandchildren more often.
family and friends.pt: Se meus pais morassem mais perto, veriam os netos com mais frequência.

family and friends.text: Kevin et Inès se sont séparés après sept ans de vie commune.
family and friends.en: Kevin and Inès split up after seven years of living together.
family and friends.pt: O Kevin e a Inès se separaram depois de sete anos morando juntos.

family and friends.text: Est-ce que vous avez des frères et sœurs, ou vous êtes fils unique ?
family and friends.en: Do you have any brothers and sisters, or are you an only child?
family and friends.pt: Você tem irmãos ou é filho único?

family and friends.text: J'ai retrouvé un vieil ami d'école grâce aux réseaux sociaux.
family and friends.en: I found an old school friend again thanks to social media.
family and friends.pt: Reencontrei um velho amigo da escola graças às redes sociais.

family and friends.text: Ma tante fait le meilleur gâteau au chocolat de toute la famille.
family and friends.en: My aunt makes the best chocolate cake in the whole family.
family and friends.pt: Minha tia faz o melhor bolo de chocolate da família inteira.

family and friends.text: Nous irons voir mon cousin jouer au football dimanche après-midi.
family and friends.en: We'll go and watch my cousin play football on Sunday afternoon.
family and friends.pt: Vamos ver meu primo jogar futebol no domingo à tarde.

family and friends.text: Je pense que les jeunes passent moins de temps avec leurs grands-parents.
family and friends.en: I think young people spend less time with their grandparents.
family and friends.pt: Acho que os jovens passam menos tempo com os avós.

family and friends.text: Mes amis m'ont beaucoup soutenu quand j'ai perdu mon travail.
family and friends.en: My friends supported me a lot when I lost my job.
family and friends.pt: Meus amigos me apoiaram muito quando perdi o emprego.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai mal à la gorge depuis trois jours et je tousse beaucoup.
health and the doctor.en: I've had a sore throat for three days and I'm coughing a lot.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com dor de garganta há três dias e tossindo muito.

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin m'a conseillé de rester au lit pendant quelques jours.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor advised me to stay in bed for a few days.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me aconselhou a ficar de cama por alguns dias.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que vous pourriez me prescrire quelque chose contre la fièvre ?
health and the doctor.en: Could you prescribe me something for the fever?
health and the doctor.pt: O senhor poderia me receitar alguma coisa para a febre?

health and the doctor.text: Je me suis tordu la cheville en courant dans le parc.
health and the doctor.en: I twisted my ankle while running in the park.
health and the doctor.pt: Torci o tornozelo correndo no parque.

health and the doctor.text: Vous devriez boire beaucoup d'eau et vous reposer.
health and the doctor.en: You should drink plenty of water and rest.
health and the doctor.pt: Você deveria beber bastante água e descansar.

health and the doctor.text: Quand j'étais petit, j'étais souvent malade en hiver.
health and the doctor.en: When I was little, I was often ill in winter.
health and the doctor.pt: Quando eu era pequeno, ficava doente com frequência no inverno.

health and the doctor.text: Je vais prendre rendez-vous chez le dentiste, j'ai mal à une dent.
health and the doctor.en: I'm going to make a dentist appointment, I have a toothache.
health and the doctor.pt: Vou marcar uma consulta no dentista, estou com dor de dente.

health and the doctor.text: Prenez ce médicament trois fois par jour pendant une semaine.
health and the doctor.en: Take this medicine three times a day for a week.
health and the doctor.pt: Tome este remédio três vezes ao dia durante uma semana.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que ce sirop peut provoquer de la somnolence ?
health and the doctor.en: Can this syrup cause drowsiness?
health and the doctor.pt: Este xarope pode causar sonolência?

health and the doctor.text: Mon père a arrêté de fumer il y a deux ans.
health and the doctor.en: My father stopped smoking two years ago.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu pai parou de fumar há dois anos.

health and the doctor.text: Si tu faisais plus de sport, tu dormirais sans doute mieux.
health and the doctor.en: If you did more exercise, you'd probably sleep better.
health and the doctor.pt: Se você fizesse mais exercício, provavelmente dormiria melhor.

health and the doctor.text: L'infirmière m'a fait un vaccin contre la grippe ce matin.
health and the doctor.en: The nurse gave me a flu jab this morning.
health and the doctor.pt: A enfermeira me deu a vacina da gripe hoje de manhã.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai l'impression que je couve quelque chose, j'ai froid depuis ce matin.
health and the doctor.en: I think I'm coming down with something, I've felt cold since this morning.
health and the doctor.pt: Acho que estou ficando doente, estou com frio desde hoje de manhã.

health and the doctor.text: Depuis combien de temps avez-vous ces douleurs au dos ?
health and the doctor.en: How long have you had this back pain?
health and the doctor.pt: Há quanto tempo você está com essas dores nas costas?

health and the doctor.text: Élodie s'est cassé le bras en faisant du ski à Chamonix.
health and the doctor.en: Élodie broke her arm skiing in Chamonix.
health and the doctor.pt: A Élodie quebrou o braço esquiando em Chamonix.

health and the doctor.text: Je me sens beaucoup mieux depuis que je mange moins de sucre.
health and the doctor.en: I feel much better since I started eating less sugar.
health and the doctor.pt: Eu me sinto muito melhor desde que passei a comer menos açúcar.

health and the doctor.text: Il faudrait que vous passiez une radio du genou.
health and the doctor.en: You ought to have an X-ray of your knee.
health and the doctor.pt: Seria bom você fazer um raio-x do joelho.

health and the doctor.text: La pharmacie de garde est ouverte toute la nuit le dimanche.
health and the doctor.en: The on-duty pharmacy is open all night on Sundays.
health and the doctor.pt: A farmácia de plantão fica aberta a noite toda aos domingos.

health and the doctor.text: Je suis allergique à la pénicilline, c'est noté dans mon dossier.
health and the doctor.en: I'm allergic to penicillin, it's noted in my file.
health and the doctor.pt: Sou alérgico à penicilina, está anotado no meu prontuário.

health and the doctor.text: On m'a dit que ce nouveau médecin était très à l'écoute.
health and the doctor.en: I was told that this new doctor is a very good listener.
health and the doctor.pt: Me disseram que esse médico novo escuta muito bem os pacientes.

health and the doctor.text: Je reviendrai vous voir si la fièvre ne baisse pas d'ici jeudi.
health and the doctor.en: I'll come back to see you if the fever doesn't go down by Thursday.
health and the doctor.pt: Volto a procurá-lo se a febre não baixar até quinta.

health and the doctor.text: Mon fils avait de la fièvre, alors je l'ai gardé à la maison.
health and the doctor.en: My son had a temperature, so I kept him at home.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu filho estava com febre, então o deixei em casa.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que la consultation est remboursée par la Sécurité sociale ?
health and the doctor.en: Is the consultation reimbursed by the national health service?
health and the doctor.pt: A consulta é reembolsada pela previdência social?

health and the doctor.text: Vous avez une ordonnance pour ces antibiotiques, monsieur ?
health and the doctor.en: Do you have a prescription for these antibiotics, sir?
health and the doctor.pt: O senhor tem receita para estes antibióticos?

health and the doctor.text: Je dors mal depuis quelques semaines à cause du stress.
health and the doctor.en: I've been sleeping badly for a few weeks because of stress.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou dormindo mal há algumas semanas por causa do estresse.

health and the doctor.text: Le kiné m'a montré des exercices pour renforcer mon dos.
health and the doctor.en: The physio showed me exercises to strengthen my back.
health and the doctor.pt: O fisioterapeuta me mostrou exercícios para fortalecer as costas.

health and the doctor.text: À mon avis, tu devrais consulter un spécialiste pour ces migraines.
health and the doctor.en: In my opinion, you should see a specialist about these migraines.
health and the doctor.pt: Na minha opinião, você deveria consultar um especialista por causa dessas enxaquecas.

health and the doctor.text: Ma grand-mère a été opérée de la hanche le mois dernier.
health and the doctor.en: My grandmother had a hip operation last month.
health and the doctor.pt: Minha avó fez uma cirurgia no quadril no mês passado.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que je dois rester à jeun avant la prise de sang ?
health and the doctor.en: Do I have to fast before the blood test?
health and the doctor.pt: Preciso ficar em jejum antes do exame de sangue?

health and the doctor.text: J'ai attendu une heure et demie dans la salle d'attente.
health and the doctor.en: I waited an hour and a half in the waiting room.
health and the doctor.pt: Esperei uma hora e meia na sala de espera.

health and the doctor.text: Si la douleur continue, il faudra faire des examens supplémentaires.
health and the doctor.en: If the pain continues, further tests will be needed.
health and the doctor.pt: Se a dor continuar, vai ser preciso fazer mais exames.

health and the doctor.text: Je me suis brûlé la main en sortant le plat du four.
health and the doctor.en: I burned my hand taking the dish out of the oven.
health and the doctor.pt: Queimei a mão ao tirar a travessa do forno.

health and the doctor.text: Mon médecin m'a donné un arrêt de travail de cinq jours.
health and the doctor.en: My doctor signed me off work for five days.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu médico me deu um atestado de cinco dias.

health and the doctor.text: Tu as mauvaise mine, tu es sûr que tu vas bien ?
health and the doctor.en: You don't look well, are you sure you're all right?
health and the doctor.pt: Você está com uma cara abatida, tem certeza de que está bem?

health and the doctor.text: Je vais essayer de marcher trente minutes par jour pour ma santé.
health and the doctor.en: I'm going to try to walk thirty minutes a day for my health.
health and the doctor.pt: Vou tentar caminhar trinta minutos por dia pela minha saúde.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que vous avez des antécédents de maladies cardiaques dans la famille ?
health and the doctor.en: Is there a history of heart disease in your family?
health and the doctor.pt: Você tem histórico de doenças cardíacas na família?

health and the doctor.text: Ce matin, je me suis réveillé enrhumé et avec mal à la tête.
health and the doctor.en: This morning, I woke up with a cold and a headache.
health and the doctor.pt: Hoje de manhã, acordei resfriado e com dor de cabeça.

health and the doctor.text: Le docteur Martin ne consulte pas le mercredi après-midi.
health and the doctor.en: Dr Martin doesn't see patients on Wednesday afternoons.
health and the doctor.pt: O doutor Martin não atende nas quartas à tarde.

health and the doctor.text: Il serait préférable d'éviter l'alcool pendant votre traitement.
health and the doctor.en: It would be better to avoid alcohol during your treatment.
health and the doctor.pt: Seria melhor evitar bebida alcoólica durante o tratamento.

health and the doctor.text: Après l'opération, j'ai dû marcher avec des béquilles pendant un mois.
health and the doctor.en: After the operation, I had to walk on crutches for a month.
health and the doctor.pt: Depois da cirurgia, tive que andar de muletas por um mês.

weather and seasons.text: Il a neigé toute la nuit et les routes sont bloquées ce matin.
weather and seasons.en: It snowed all night and the roads are blocked this morning.
weather and seasons.pt: Nevou a noite toda e as estradas estão bloqueadas hoje de manhã.

weather and seasons.text: Selon la météo, il fera beau et chaud tout le week-end.
weather and seasons.en: According to the forecast, it'll be sunny and warm all weekend.
weather and seasons.pt: Segundo a previsão do tempo, vai fazer sol e calor o fim de semana inteiro.

weather and seasons.text: Quand j'étais enfant, les hivers étaient beaucoup plus froids qu'aujourd'hui.
weather and seasons.en: When I was a child, winters were much colder than today.
weather and seasons.pt: Quando eu era criança, os invernos eram muito mais frios do que hoje.

weather and seasons.text: Tu devrais prendre un parapluie, le ciel est vraiment gris.
weather and seasons.en: You should take an umbrella, the sky is really grey.
weather and seasons.pt: Você deveria levar um guarda-chuva, o céu está bem cinzento.

weather and seasons.text: J'adore l'automne, surtout quand les feuilles changent de couleur.
weather and seasons.en: I love autumn, especially when the leaves change colour.
weather and seasons.pt: Adoro o outono, principalmente quando as folhas mudam de cor.

weather and seasons.text: Il faisait tellement chaud que nous avons dormi avec les fenêtres ouvertes.
weather and seasons.en: It was so hot that we slept with the windows open.
weather and seasons.pt: Fazia tanto calor que dormimos com as janelas abertas.

weather and seasons.text: Est-ce que tu crois qu'il va pleuvoir pendant le pique-nique ?
weather and seasons.en: Do you think it's going to rain during the picnic?
weather and seasons.pt: Você acha que vai chover durante o piquenique?

weather and seasons.text: Au printemps, nous planterons des fleurs dans le jardin.
weather and seasons.en: In spring, we'll plant flowers in the garden.
weather and seasons.pt: Na primavera, vamos plantar flores no jardim.

weather and seasons.text: L'orage d'hier soir a fait tomber plusieurs arbres dans la rue.
weather and seasons.en: Last night's storm brought down several trees in the street.
weather and seasons.pt: A tempestade de ontem à noite derrubou várias árvores na rua.

weather and seasons.text: Si le temps le permet, on ira se promener au bord de la mer.
weather and seasons.en: If the weather allows, we'll go for a walk by the sea.
weather and seasons.pt: Se o tempo permitir, vamos passear à beira-mar.

weather and seasons.text: Je préfère l'hiver parce que j'aime faire du ski en montagne.
weather and seasons.en: I prefer winter because I like skiing in the mountains.
weather and seasons.pt: Prefiro o inverno porque gosto de esquiar nas montanhas.

weather and seasons.text: Il y avait tellement de brouillard qu'on ne voyait rien sur la route.
weather and seasons.en: There was so much fog that you couldn't see anything on the road.
weather and seasons.pt: Tinha tanta neblina que não se via nada na estrada.

weather and seasons.text: Cet été, les températures ont dépassé quarante degrés dans le Sud.
weather and seasons.en: This summer, temperatures went above forty degrees in the South.
weather and seasons.pt: Neste verão, as temperaturas passaram de quarenta graus no Sul.

weather and seasons.text: On annonce de la pluie pour toute la semaine prochaine, malheureusement.
weather and seasons.en: Rain is forecast for the whole of next week, unfortunately.
weather and seasons.pt: Infelizmente, estão prevendo chuva para a semana que vem inteira.

weather and seasons.text: Les enfants ont fait un bonhomme de neige devant la maison.
weather and seasons.en: The children made a snowman in front of the house.
weather and seasons.pt: As crianças fizeram um boneco de neve na frente da casa.

weather and seasons.text: À mon avis, le climat change de plus en plus vite.
weather and seasons.en: In my opinion, the climate is changing faster and faster.
weather and seasons.pt: Na minha opinião, o clima está mudando cada vez mais rápido.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait un temps magnifique, on pourrait déjeuner sur la terrasse ?
weather and seasons.en: The weather is gorgeous, shall we have lunch on the terrace?
weather and seasons.pt: O tempo está maravilhoso, que tal almoçarmos na varanda?

weather and seasons.text: Nous avons été surpris par une averse en rentrant de l'école.
weather and seasons.en: We were caught in a shower on the way home from school.
weather and seasons.pt: Fomos pegos por um temporal voltando da escola.

weather and seasons.text: Je mettrai mon gros manteau demain, il va geler pendant la nuit.
weather and seasons.en: I'll wear my thick coat tomorrow, it's going to freeze overnight.
weather and seasons.pt: Amanhã vou vestir meu casaco grosso, vai gear durante a noite.

weather and seasons.text: Le vent soufflait si fort que le parasol s'est envolé.
weather and seasons.en: The wind was blowing so hard that the parasol blew away.
weather and seasons.pt: O vento soprava tão forte que o guarda-sol saiu voando.

weather and seasons.text: Ma saison préférée est le printemps, quand tout recommence à fleurir.
weather and seasons.en: My favourite season is spring, when everything starts to bloom again.
weather and seasons.pt: Minha estação preferida é a primavera, quando tudo volta a florescer.

weather and seasons.text: Est-ce qu'il neige souvent dans ta région en hiver ?
weather and seasons.en: Does it often snow in your region in winter?
weather and seasons.pt: Neva muito na sua região no inverno?

weather and seasons.text: Il a fait gris pendant toutes nos vacances en Normandie.
weather and seasons.en: It was grey for our entire holiday in Normandy.
weather and seasons.pt: O tempo ficou nublado durante todas as nossas férias na Normandia.

weather and seasons.text: Si seulement il faisait un peu plus chaud, on pourrait se baigner.
weather and seasons.en: If only it were a bit warmer, we could go swimming.
weather and seasons.pt: Se pelo menos estivesse um pouco mais quente, a gente poderia nadar.

weather and seasons.text: Les jours raccourcissent vite à partir du mois d'octobre.
weather and seasons.en: The days get shorter quickly from October onwards.
weather and seasons.pt: Os dias ficam mais curtos rapidamente a partir de outubro.

weather and seasons.text: Mes grands-parents disaient qu'un ciel rouge le soir annonçait du beau temps.
weather and seasons.en: My grandparents used to say that a red sky at night meant good weather.
weather and seasons.pt: Meus avós diziam que céu vermelho ao entardecer anunciava tempo bom.

weather and seasons.text: Prends tes lunettes de soleil, il y a beaucoup de lumière aujourd'hui.
weather and seasons.en: Take your sunglasses, it's very bright today.
weather and seasons.pt: Leve seus óculos de sol, está muito claro hoje.

weather and seasons.text: La canicule a duré presque deux semaines au mois d'août.
weather and seasons.en: The heatwave lasted almost two weeks in August.
weather and seasons.pt: A onda de calor durou quase duas semanas em agosto.

weather and seasons.text: Je trouve que l'hiver est trop long et trop sombre à Lille.
weather and seasons.en: I find that winter is too long and too dark in Lille.
weather and seasons.pt: Acho que o inverno em Lille é longo e escuro demais.

weather and seasons.text: Il pleuvait des cordes quand nous sommes arrivés à la gare.
weather and seasons.en: It was pouring with rain when we arrived at the station.
weather and seasons.pt: Estava chovendo canivetes quando chegamos à estação.

weather and seasons.text: D'après les prévisions, la neige devrait arriver jeudi en fin de journée.
weather and seasons.en: According to the forecast, the snow should arrive late on Thursday.
weather and seasons.pt: Segundo a previsão, a neve deve chegar na quinta no fim do dia.

weather and seasons.text: Nous avons dû annuler le match à cause de la pluie.
weather and seasons.en: We had to cancel the match because of the rain.
weather and seasons.pt: Tivemos que cancelar o jogo por causa da chuva.

weather and seasons.text: En été, je me lève tôt pour courir avant la chaleur.
weather and seasons.en: In summer, I get up early to go running before the heat.
weather and seasons.pt: No verão, acordo cedo para correr antes do calor.

weather and seasons.text: Quel temps fait-il chez toi à Montréal en ce moment ?
weather and seasons.en: What's the weather like where you are in Montreal right now?
weather and seasons.pt: Como está o tempo aí em Montreal agora?

weather and seasons.text: Les agriculteurs attendent la pluie depuis plusieurs semaines.
weather and seasons.en: Farmers have been waiting for rain for several weeks.
weather and seasons.pt: Os agricultores esperam chuva há várias semanas.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait encore doux pour un mois de novembre, tu ne trouves pas ?
weather and seasons.en: It's still mild for November, don't you think?
weather and seasons.pt: Ainda está ameno para novembro, você não acha?

weather and seasons.text: L'hiver dernier, le lac était complètement gelé pendant un mois.
weather and seasons.en: Last winter, the lake was completely frozen for a month.
weather and seasons.pt: No inverno passado, o lago ficou completamente congelado durante um mês.

weather and seasons.text: Je n'aime pas l'été en ville, il fait trop lourd.
weather and seasons.en: I don't like summer in the city, it's too muggy.
weather and seasons.pt: Não gosto do verão na cidade, fica abafado demais.

weather and seasons.text: Le soleil se couchera vers vingt-deux heures au début de l'été.
weather and seasons.en: The sun will set at around ten p.m. at the start of summer.
weather and seasons.pt: O sol vai se pôr por volta das vinte e duas horas no início do verão.

weather and seasons.text: Il y aura sûrement un arc-en-ciel après cette petite pluie.
weather and seasons.en: There'll surely be a rainbow after this light rain.
weather and seasons.pt: Com certeza vai ter um arco-íris depois dessa chuvinha.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le samedi matin, je joue au tennis avec mon voisin.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Saturday mornings, I play tennis with my neighbour.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Aos sábados de manhã, jogo tênis com meu vizinho.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous sommes allés voir un très bon film au cinéma hier soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: We went to see a very good film at the cinema last night.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fomos ver um filme muito bom no cinema ontem à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'aimerais apprendre à jouer de la guitare l'année prochaine.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'd like to learn to play the guitar next year.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu gostaria de aprender a tocar violão no ano que vem.

hobbies and weekends.text: Quand j'étais adolescent, je passais des heures à lire des bandes dessinées.
hobbies and weekends.en: When I was a teenager, I spent hours reading comics.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quando eu era adolescente, passava horas lendo quadrinhos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ce week-end, on va faire une randonnée dans les Alpes.
hobbies and weekends.en: This weekend, we're going hiking in the Alps.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste fim de semana, vamos fazer uma trilha nos Alpes.

hobbies and weekends.text: Est-ce que tu as déjà essayé l'escalade en salle ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Have you ever tried indoor climbing?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você já experimentou escalada indoor?

hobbies and weekends.text: Si j'avais plus de temps libre, je ferais de la peinture.
hobbies and weekends.en: If I had more free time, I would take up painting.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo livre, pintaria quadros.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ma sœur fait partie d'une chorale depuis plus de dix ans.
hobbies and weekends.en: My sister has been in a choir for more than ten years.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Minha irmã participa de um coral há mais de dez anos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Dimanche dernier, nous avons fait une balade à vélo le long du canal.
hobbies and weekends.en: Last Sunday, we went for a bike ride along the canal.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo passado, fizemos um passeio de bicicleta ao longo do canal.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je trouve que la photographie est un loisir très relaxant.
hobbies and weekends.en: I find photography a very relaxing hobby.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Acho a fotografia um passatempo muito relaxante.

hobbies and weekends.text: On pourrait aller au marché aux puces samedi matin, ça te dit ?
hobbies and weekends.en: We could go to the flea market on Saturday morning, do you fancy it?
hobbies and weekends.pt: A gente podia ir à feira de antiguidades no sábado de manhã, topa?

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon père passe tous ses week-ends à pêcher au bord de la rivière.
hobbies and weekends.en: My father spends every weekend fishing by the river.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu pai passa todos os fins de semana pescando na beira do rio.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai commencé le yoga il y a six mois et je me sens mieux.
hobbies and weekends.en: I started yoga six months ago and I feel better.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Comecei a fazer ioga há seis meses e me sinto melhor.

hobbies and weekends.text: Est-ce que tu viendras jouer aux cartes chez nous vendredi soir ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Will you come and play cards at our place on Friday evening?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você vem jogar cartas lá em casa na sexta à noite?

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avons visité une exposition sur les impressionnistes au musée.
hobbies and weekends.en: We visited an exhibition on the Impressionists at the museum.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Visitamos uma exposição sobre os impressionistas no museu.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je ne fais rien de spécial ce week-end, je vais juste me reposer.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm not doing anything special this weekend, I'm just going to rest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Não vou fazer nada de especial neste fim de semana, só vou descansar.

hobbies and weekends.text: Romain s'est inscrit à un club de théâtre pour vaincre sa timidité.
hobbies and weekends.en: Romain joined a drama club to overcome his shyness.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Romain se inscreveu num grupo de teatro para vencer a timidez.

hobbies and weekends.text: Avant, je jouais du piano, mais j'ai arrêté à cause du travail.
hobbies and weekends.en: I used to play the piano, but I stopped because of work.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Antes eu tocava piano, mas parei por causa do trabalho.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le dimanche, nous préparons souvent un grand repas pour toute la famille.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sundays, we often cook a big meal for the whole family.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Aos domingos, muitas vezes preparamos um almoço grande para a família toda.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu préfères les jeux de société ou les jeux vidéo ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you prefer board games or video games?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você prefere jogos de tabuleiro ou videogames?

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai lu trois romans pendant mes vacances au bord de la mer.
hobbies and weekends.en: I read three novels during my holiday by the sea.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Li três romances durante minhas férias na praia.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous irons au concert de jazz en plein air samedi soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: We'll go to the open-air jazz concert on Saturday night.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vamos ao show de jazz ao ar livre no sábado à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: À mon avis, le jardinage est la meilleure façon de se détendre.
hobbies and weekends.en: In my opinion, gardening is the best way to relax.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Na minha opinião, jardinagem é a melhor forma de relaxar.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je cours un semi-marathon en avril, alors je m'entraîne beaucoup.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm running a half marathon in April, so I'm training a lot.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vou correr uma meia maratona em abril, então estou treinando muito.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mes enfants adorent aller à la piscine le mercredi après-midi.
hobbies and weekends.en: My children love going to the swimming pool on Wednesday afternoons.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meus filhos adoram ir à piscina nas quartas à tarde.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si tu veux, je pourrais te montrer comment faire du pain maison.
hobbies and weekends.en: If you like, I could show you how to make homemade bread.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se quiser, eu poderia te mostrar como fazer pão caseiro.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le week-end dernier, il a plu, alors on a regardé des séries.
hobbies and weekends.en: Last weekend it rained, so we watched TV series.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No fim de semana passado choveu, então assistimos a séries.

hobbies and weekends.text: Lucie collectionne les timbres anciens depuis qu'elle est toute petite.
hobbies and weekends.en: Lucie has been collecting old stamps since she was very little.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A Lucie coleciona selos antigos desde pequenininha.

hobbies and weekends.text: Est-ce que tu voudrais venir danser la salsa avec nous jeudi ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Would you like to come salsa dancing with us on Thursday?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você gostaria de ir dançar salsa com a gente na quinta?

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai fabriqué une étagère en bois pour ma chambre.
hobbies and weekends.en: I made a wooden shelf for my bedroom.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fiz uma prateleira de madeira para o meu quarto.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avions prévu un pique-nique, mais finalement nous sommes restés à la maison.
hobbies and weekends.en: We had planned a picnic, but in the end we stayed at home.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Tínhamos planejado um piquenique, mas no fim ficamos em casa.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je vais m'inscrire à un cours de cuisine italienne le mardi soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm going to sign up for an Italian cooking class on Tuesday evenings.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vou me inscrever num curso de culinária italiana às terças à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon grand-père faisait des maquettes de bateaux dans son garage.
hobbies and weekends.en: My grandfather used to build model boats in his garage.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu avô fazia maquetes de barcos na garagem dele.

hobbies and weekends.text: Qu'est-ce que vous faites d'habitude le dimanche après-midi ?
hobbies and weekends.en: What do you usually do on Sunday afternoons?
hobbies and weekends.pt: O que vocês costumam fazer no domingo à tarde?

hobbies and weekends.text: On a passé la soirée à jouer aux échecs chez Mathieu.
hobbies and weekends.en: We spent the evening playing chess at Mathieu's.
