hobbies and weekends.pt: Passamos a noite jogando xadrez na casa do Mathieu.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'aimerais bien partir en week-end à la montagne avec des amis.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'd really like to go away for a weekend in the mountains with friends.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu adoraria passar um fim de semana na montanha com amigos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Elle tricote des écharpes pour toute la famille chaque hiver.
hobbies and weekends.en: She knits scarves for the whole family every winter.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Ela tricota cachecóis para a família toda todo inverno.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le club de foot cherche des bénévoles pour le tournoi de juin.
hobbies and weekends.en: The football club is looking for volunteers for the June tournament.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O clube de futebol está procurando voluntários para o torneio de junho.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je regarderais moins la télévision si j'avais un vrai passe-temps.
hobbies and weekends.en: I would watch less television if I had a real hobby.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu veria menos televisão se tivesse um passatempo de verdade.

hobbies and weekends.text: Samedi prochain, nous visiterons les jardins du château de Versailles.
hobbies and weekends.en: Next Saturday, we'll visit the gardens of the Palace of Versailles.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No próximo sábado, vamos visitar os jardins do Palácio de Versalhes.

home and daily routine.text: Je me lève à six heures et demie tous les jours de la semaine.
home and daily routine.en: I get up at half past six every weekday.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu acordo às seis e meia todos os dias da semana.

home and daily routine.text: Avant de partir au travail, je prends toujours un café avec un croissant.
home and daily routine.en: Before leaving for work, I always have a coffee with a croissant.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de sair para o trabalho, sempre tomo um café com um croissant.

home and daily routine.text: Hier soir, j'ai oublié de fermer la porte à clé.
home and daily routine.en: Last night, I forgot to lock the door.
home and daily routine.pt: Ontem à noite, esqueci de trancar a porta.

home and daily routine.text: Est-ce que tu pourrais sortir les poubelles avant d'aller te coucher ?
home and daily routine.en: Could you take the bins out before you go to bed?
home and daily routine.pt: Você poderia levar o lixo para fora antes de ir dormir?

home and daily routine.text: Quand j'habitais seul, je mangeais souvent devant la télévision.
home and daily routine.en: When I lived alone, I often ate in front of the television.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando eu morava sozinho, comia muitas vezes na frente da televisão.

home and daily routine.text: Nous allons repeindre la cuisine en blanc le mois prochain.
home and daily routine.en: We're going to repaint the kitchen white next month.
home and daily routine.pt: Vamos pintar a cozinha de branco no mês que vem.

home and daily routine.text: Le week-end, c'est mon mari qui fait le ménage et moi la cuisine.
home and daily routine.en: At weekends, my husband does the cleaning and I do the cooking.
home and daily routine.pt: No fim de semana, meu marido faz a faxina e eu cozinho.

home and daily routine.text: Le chauffe-eau est tombé en panne, alors j'ai pris une douche froide.
home and daily routine.en: The water heater broke down, so I had a cold shower.
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecedor de água quebrou, então tomei um banho frio.

home and daily routine.text: Si notre appartement était plus grand, nous aurions un bureau.
home and daily routine.en: If our flat were bigger, we would have a study.
home and daily routine.pt: Se nosso apartamento fosse maior, teríamos um escritório.

home and daily routine.text: Les enfants doivent ranger leur chambre avant de jouer.
home and daily routine.en: The children have to tidy their room before playing.
home and daily routine.pt: As crianças têm que arrumar o quarto antes de brincar.

home and daily routine.text: Je prends le bus à huit heures moins le quart pour aller au bureau.
home and daily routine.en: I take the bus at a quarter to eight to go to the office.
home and daily routine.pt: Pego o ônibus às quinze para as oito para ir ao escritório.

home and daily routine.text: Je vais faire une lessive, tu as du linge sale ?
home and daily routine.en: I'm going to do a load of washing, do you have any dirty clothes?
home and daily routine.pt: Vou lavar roupa, você tem alguma roupa suja?

home and daily routine.text: Nous avons déménagé dans un appartement plus lumineux au printemps dernier.
home and daily routine.en: We moved into a brighter flat last spring.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós nos mudamos para um apartamento mais iluminado na primavera passada.

home and daily routine.text: Le soir, je lis toujours un peu avant de m'endormir.
home and daily routine.en: In the evening, I always read a little before falling asleep.
home and daily routine.pt: À noite, sempre leio um pouco antes de dormir.

home and daily routine.text: Est-ce que tu as pensé à arroser les plantes ce matin ?
home and daily routine.en: Did you remember to water the plants this morning?
home and daily routine.pt: Você lembrou de regar as plantas hoje de manhã?

home and daily routine.text: Mon réveil n'a pas sonné, alors je suis arrivé en retard.
home and daily routine.en: My alarm didn't go off, so I arrived late.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu despertador não tocou, então cheguei atrasado.

home and daily routine.text: J'aimerais avoir un jardin pour faire pousser des légumes.
home and daily routine.en: I'd like to have a garden to grow vegetables.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu gostaria de ter um quintal para plantar legumes.

home and daily routine.text: Qui va faire la vaisselle ce soir, toi ou moi ?
home and daily routine.en: Who's going to do the dishes tonight, you or me?
home and daily routine.pt: Quem vai lavar a louça hoje à noite, você ou eu?

home and daily routine.text: Avant, je me couchais très tard, mais maintenant je suis plus raisonnable.
home and daily routine.en: I used to go to bed very late, but now I'm more sensible.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes eu ia dormir muito tarde, mas agora sou mais sensato.

home and daily routine.text: Le lave-vaisselle fait un bruit bizarre depuis hier.
home and daily routine.en: The dishwasher has been making a strange noise since yesterday.
home and daily routine.pt: A lava-louças está fazendo um barulho estranho desde ontem.

home and daily routine.text: Je passerai l'aspirateur demain matin, je suis trop fatigué ce soir.
home and daily routine.en: I'll vacuum tomorrow morning, I'm too tired tonight.
home and daily routine.pt: Passo o aspirador amanhã de manhã, estou cansado demais hoje à noite.

home and daily routine.text: Chez nous, on dîne toujours ensemble vers vingt heures.
home and daily routine.en: At our house, we always have dinner together at around eight p.m.
home and daily routine.pt: Lá em casa, sempre jantamos juntos por volta das vinte horas.

home and daily routine.text: Il faudrait changer l'ampoule de la salle de bain, elle ne marche plus.
home and daily routine.en: We need to change the bathroom light bulb, it doesn't work any more.
home and daily routine.pt: Precisamos trocar a lâmpada do banheiro, ela não funciona mais.

home and daily routine.text: Mon colocataire laisse toujours ses chaussures au milieu du couloir.
home and daily routine.en: My flatmate always leaves his shoes in the middle of the hallway.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu colega de apartamento sempre deixa os sapatos no meio do corredor.

home and daily routine.text: Le matin, j'emmène les enfants à l'école avant d'aller travailler.
home and daily routine.en: In the morning, I take the children to school before going to work.
home and daily routine.pt: De manhã, levo as crianças à escola antes de ir trabalhar.

home and daily routine.text: Si tu rentres avant moi, tu pourrais mettre le rôti au four ?
home and daily routine.en: If you get home before me, could you put the roast in the oven?
home and daily routine.pt: Se você chegar antes de mim, poderia colocar o assado no forno?

home and daily routine.text: Le samedi, je fais la grasse matinée jusqu'à dix heures.
home and daily routine.en: On Saturdays, I have a lie-in until ten o'clock.
home and daily routine.pt: Aos sábados, durmo até tarde, até as dez horas.

home and daily routine.text: Je trouve que notre quartier est calme et très agréable le soir.
home and daily routine.en: I find our neighbourhood quiet and very pleasant in the evening.
home and daily routine.pt: Acho nosso bairro tranquilo e muito agradável à noite.

home and daily routine.text: Le plombier passera jeudi pour réparer la fuite sous l'évier.
home and daily routine.en: The plumber will come by on Thursday to fix the leak under the sink.
home and daily routine.pt: O encanador vai passar na quinta para consertar o vazamento embaixo da pia.

home and daily routine.text: Je repasse mes chemises le dimanche soir pour toute la semaine.
home and daily routine.en: I iron my shirts on Sunday evening for the whole week.
home and daily routine.pt: Passo minhas camisas no domingo à noite para a semana toda.

home and daily routine.text: Quand nous étions petits, notre mère nous préparait un chocolat chaud au réveil.
home and daily routine.en: When we were little, our mother made us a hot chocolate when we woke up.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando éramos pequenos, nossa mãe preparava um chocolate quente para nós ao acordar.

home and daily routine.text: Est-ce que tu as éteint le four avant de partir ?
home and daily routine.en: Did you turn off the oven before leaving?
home and daily routine.pt: Você desligou o forno antes de sair?

home and daily routine.text: On devrait ranger le garage, on ne trouve plus rien.
home and daily routine.en: We should tidy the garage, we can't find anything any more.
home and daily routine.pt: A gente devia arrumar a garagem, não se acha mais nada.

home and daily routine.text: Je fais toujours mes courses le jeudi après le travail.
home and daily routine.en: I always do my shopping on Thursdays after work.
home and daily routine.pt: Sempre faço compras às quintas depois do trabalho.

home and daily routine.text: Il y avait une araignée énorme dans la baignoire ce matin.
home and daily routine.en: There was a huge spider in the bath this morning.
home and daily routine.pt: Tinha uma aranha enorme na banheira hoje de manhã.

home and daily routine.text: Nous aimerions installer des panneaux solaires sur le toit de la maison.
home and daily routine.en: We'd like to install solar panels on the roof of the house.
home and daily routine.pt: Gostaríamos de instalar painéis solares no telhado da casa.

home and daily routine.text: Après le dîner, je promène le chien dans le parc à côté.
home and daily routine.en: After dinner, I walk the dog in the park next door.
home and daily routine.pt: Depois do jantar, levo o cachorro para passear no parque ao lado.

home and daily routine.text: Le chauffage ne marchait pas, alors nous avons dormi avec deux couvertures.
home and daily routine.en: The heating wasn't working, so we slept with two blankets.
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecimento não funcionava, então dormimos com dois cobertores.

home and daily routine.text: Demain, je me lèverai plus tôt pour aller courir avant le travail.
home and daily routine.en: Tomorrow, I'll get up earlier to go running before work.
home and daily routine.pt: Amanhã, vou acordar mais cedo para correr antes do trabalho.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis vraiment content que tu sois venu à ma fête.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really glad you came to my party.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou muito feliz que você tenha vindo à minha festa.

feelings and opinions.text: À mon avis, les réseaux sociaux ont trop d'influence sur les jeunes.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, social media has too much influence on young people.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, as redes sociais têm influência demais sobre os jovens.

feelings and opinions.text: J'étais très nerveux avant mon examen de conduite.
feelings and opinions.en: I was very nervous before my driving test.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu estava muito nervoso antes da prova de direção.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne suis pas d'accord, la ville est plus agréable que la campagne.
feelings and opinions.en: I don't agree, the city is nicer than the countryside.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não concordo, a cidade é mais agradável que o campo.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça m'énerve quand les gens parlent fort au téléphone dans le train.
feelings and opinions.en: It annoys me when people talk loudly on the phone on the train.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me irrita quando as pessoas falam alto no celular dentro do trem.

feelings and opinions.text: Est-ce que tu as été déçu par la fin du film ?
feelings and opinions.en: Were you disappointed by the end of the film?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você ficou decepcionado com o final do filme?

feelings and opinions.text: J'aurais aimé faire des études de médecine, mais j'ai changé d'avis.
feelings and opinions.en: I would have liked to study medicine, but I changed my mind.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu teria gostado de estudar medicina, mas mudei de ideia.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle était triste parce que son meilleur ami partait vivre à l'étranger.
feelings and opinions.en: She was sad because her best friend was moving abroad.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela estava triste porque o melhor amigo ia morar no exterior.

feelings and opinions.text: Je pense que ce serait une bonne idée de partir plus tôt.
feelings and opinions.en: I think it would be a good idea to leave earlier.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que seria uma boa ideia sair mais cedo.

feelings and opinions.text: Franchement, je ne comprends pas pourquoi il a refusé ce poste.
feelings and opinions.en: Frankly, I don't understand why he turned down that job.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, não entendo por que ele recusou esse cargo.

feelings and opinions.text: On était tous très fiers de Clément quand il a eu son diplôme.
feelings and opinions.en: We were all very proud of Clément when he got his degree.
feelings and opinions.pt: Todos nós ficamos muito orgulhosos do Clément quando ele se formou.

feelings and opinions.text: Qu'est-ce que tu penses de la nouvelle bibliothèque du quartier ?
feelings and opinions.en: What do you think of the new library in the neighbourhood?
feelings and opinions.pt: O que você acha da nova biblioteca do bairro?

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai peur de prendre l'avion depuis que j'ai eu un vol difficile.
feelings and opinions.en: I've been afraid of flying since I had a rough flight.
feelings and opinions.pt: Tenho medo de andar de avião desde que tive um voo difícil.

feelings and opinions.text: Si j'étais toi, je lui dirais la vérité tout de suite.
feelings and opinions.en: If I were you, I'd tell him the truth straight away.
feelings and opinions.pt: Se eu fosse você, contaria a verdade para ele agora mesmo.

feelings and opinions.text: Je me sens un peu seul depuis que mes enfants ont quitté la maison.
feelings and opinions.en: I've felt a bit lonely since my children left home.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu me sinto um pouco sozinho desde que meus filhos saíram de casa.

feelings and opinions.text: À mon avis, ce livre est beaucoup mieux que son adaptation au cinéma.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, this book is much better than its film adaptation.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, este livro é muito melhor que a adaptação para o cinema.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai été très surpris d'apprendre qu'ils allaient se marier.
feelings and opinions.en: I was very surprised to learn that they were getting married.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei muito surpreso ao saber que eles iam se casar.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me ferait vraiment plaisir que vous veniez nous voir cet été.
feelings and opinions.en: I'd be really pleased if you came to see us this summer.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu ficaria muito feliz se vocês viessem nos visitar neste verão.

feelings and opinions.text: Je trouve injuste que les femmes soient moins payées que les hommes.
feelings and opinions.en: I think it's unfair that women are paid less than men.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho injusto que as mulheres ganhem menos que os homens.

feelings and opinions.text: Il était furieux parce que personne ne l'avait prévenu du changement.
feelings and opinions.en: He was furious because nobody had told him about the change.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ele estava furioso porque ninguém o tinha avisado da mudança.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis convaincu que nous trouverons une solution ensemble.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm convinced that we'll find a solution together.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou convencido de que vamos encontrar uma solução juntos.

feelings and opinions.text: Ne t'inquiète pas, tout va bien se passer demain.
feelings and opinions.en: Don't worry, everything will go fine tomorrow.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não se preocupe, vai dar tudo certo amanhã.

feelings and opinions.text: Je regrette de ne pas avoir appris l'espagnol quand j'étais jeune.
feelings and opinions.en: I regret not learning Spanish when I was young.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu me arrependo de não ter aprendido espanhol quando era jovem.

feelings and opinions.text: Ce qui me rend heureux, c'est de passer du temps avec mes amis.
feelings and opinions.en: What makes me happy is spending time with my friends.
feelings and opinions.pt: O que me deixa feliz é passar tempo com meus amigos.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu ne trouves pas que ce restaurant est un peu surestimé ?
feelings and opinions.en: Don't you think this restaurant is a bit overrated?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você não acha que este restaurante é um pouco superestimado?

feelings and opinions.text: J'avoue que j'étais un peu jaloux de son succès au début.
feelings and opinions.en: I admit I was a bit jealous of his success at first.
feelings and opinions.pt: Confesso que no começo eu tinha um pouco de inveja do sucesso dele.

feelings and opinions.text: Nous sommes soulagés que l'opération de notre père se soit bien passée.
feelings and opinions.en: We're relieved that our father's operation went well.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estamos aliviados porque a cirurgia do nosso pai correu bem.

feelings and opinions.text: Personnellement, je préfère les vacances calmes aux voyages organisés.
feelings and opinions.en: Personally, I prefer quiet holidays to package tours.
feelings and opinions.pt: Pessoalmente, prefiro férias tranquilas a pacotes de viagem.

feelings and opinions.text: Je serais déçu si le concert était annulé à la dernière minute.
feelings and opinions.en: I'd be disappointed if the concert were cancelled at the last minute.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu ficaria decepcionado se o show fosse cancelado na última hora.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle a l'air fatiguée et un peu stressée ces derniers temps.
feelings and opinions.en: She's been looking tired and a bit stressed lately.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela parece cansada e um pouco estressada ultimamente.

feelings and opinions.text: Je crois que tu as raison, nous devrions attendre encore un peu.
feelings and opinions.en: I think you're right, we should wait a little longer.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que você tem razão, deveríamos esperar mais um pouco.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça m'a fait de la peine de voir mon frère si malheureux.
feelings and opinions.en: It hurt me to see my brother so unhappy.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me doeu ver meu irmão tão infeliz.

feelings and opinions.text: Il me semble que les gens sont plus aimables dans les petites villes.
feelings and opinions.en: It seems to me that people are friendlier in small towns.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me parece que as pessoas são mais simpáticas nas cidades pequenas.

feelings and opinions.text: J'en ai assez de ce bruit, je n'arrive pas à me concentrer.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm fed up with this noise, I can't concentrate.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou cansado desse barulho, não consigo me concentrar.

feelings and opinions.text: Quand j'ai reçu sa lettre, j'étais tellement ému que j'ai pleuré.
feelings and opinions.en: When I received her letter, I was so moved that I cried.
feelings and opinions.pt: Quando recebi a carta dela, fiquei tão emocionado que chorei.

feelings and opinions.text: Selon moi, il faudrait investir davantage dans les transports publics.
feelings and opinions.en: In my view, we should invest more in public transport.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, seria preciso investir mais no transporte público.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis un peu inquiet, Pauline n'a toujours pas répondu à mes messages.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm a bit worried, Pauline still hasn't answered my messages.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou um pouco preocupado, a Pauline ainda não respondeu às minhas mensagens.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis impatient de commencer mon nouveau travail lundi prochain.
feelings and opinions.en: I can't wait to start my new job next Monday.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou ansioso para começar no meu novo emprego na próxima segunda.

feelings and opinions.text: Je n'aurais jamais cru que ce film me ferait autant rire.
feelings and opinions.en: I'd never have thought this film would make me laugh so much.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu nunca teria imaginado que esse filme me faria rir tanto.

feelings and opinions.text: Honnêtement, je pense que nous avons pris la bonne décision.
feelings and opinions.en: Honestly, I think we made the right decision.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, acho que tomamos a decisão certa.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonjour, madame Petit, vous avez passé de bonnes vacances ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Hello, Mrs Petit, did you have a good holiday?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, dona Petit, a senhora teve boas férias?

small talk with a neighbour.text: J'ai vu que vous aviez repeint vos volets, c'est très joli.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I saw that you'd repainted your shutters, they look lovely.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vi que o senhor pintou as venezianas, ficou muito bonito.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous savez si la boulangerie du coin sera ouverte lundi ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know if the bakery on the corner will be open on Monday?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você sabe se a padaria da esquina vai abrir na segunda?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il paraît qu'un nouveau restaurant va ouvrir au bout de la rue.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Apparently a new restaurant is going to open at the end of the street.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Parece que vai abrir um restaurante novo no fim da rua.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chien a aboyé toute la matinée, tout va bien chez vous ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your dog was barking all morning, is everything all right at your place?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu cachorro latiu a manhã inteira, está tudo bem aí na sua casa?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je pourrais vous emprunter une échelle pour ce week-end ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Could I borrow a ladder from you for this weekend?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu poderia pegar uma escada emprestada com você neste fim de semana?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les travaux dans l'immeuble devraient se terminer à la fin du mois.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The work in the building should be finished by the end of the month.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As obras no prédio devem terminar no fim do mês.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça fait longtemps que vous habitez dans le quartier ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you lived in the neighbourhood for long?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Faz tempo que você mora no bairro?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Nous allons organiser une fête des voisins dans la cour en juin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: We're going to organise a neighbours' party in the courtyard in June.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vamos organizar uma festa dos vizinhos no pátio em junho.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si vous partez en vacances, je pourrais arroser vos plantes.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you go on holiday, I could water your plants.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se vocês viajarem de férias, eu poderia regar suas plantas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le facteur a laissé un colis pour vous chez moi ce matin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The postman left a parcel for you at my place this morning.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O carteiro deixou uma encomenda para você aqui em casa hoje de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vos enfants ont bien grandi depuis l'année dernière !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your children have really grown since last year!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seus filhos cresceram muito desde o ano passado!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Avant, il y avait un marché sur la place tous les mardis.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There used to be a market in the square every Tuesday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Antes tinha uma feira na praça toda terça-feira.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez entendu le bruit de la sirène hier soir vers minuit ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you hear the siren last night around midnight?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você ouviu o barulho da sirene ontem à noite por volta da meia-noite?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je suis désolé pour le bruit, nous avons fêté l'anniversaire de mon fils.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm sorry about the noise, we were celebrating my son's birthday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe pelo barulho, comemoramos o aniversário do meu filho.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Est-ce que vous connaissez un bon électricien dans le coin ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know a good electrician around here?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você conhece um bom eletricista aqui por perto?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre jardin est magnifique, vous y passez beaucoup de temps ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your garden is beautiful, do you spend a lot of time in it?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu jardim está lindo, você passa muito tempo nele?

small talk with a neighbour.text: L'ascenseur est encore en panne, j'ai dû monter six étages à pied.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The lift is broken again, I had to walk up six floors.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O elevador quebrou de novo, tive que subir seis andares a pé.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Monsieur Bernard a déménagé, la nouvelle locataire arrive samedi.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Mr Bernard has moved out, the new tenant arrives on Saturday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O seu Bernard se mudou, a nova inquilina chega no sábado.

small talk with a neighbour.text: On dirait que l'été est enfin arrivé, vous ne trouvez pas ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It looks like summer has finally arrived, don't you think?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Parece que o verão finalmente chegou, você não acha?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si vous avez besoin de quoi que ce soit, n'hésitez pas à sonner.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you need anything at all, don't hesitate to ring the bell.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se precisar de qualquer coisa, não hesite em tocar a campainha.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Félicitations à votre fille, j'ai appris qu'elle avait réussi son bac !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Congratulations to your daughter, I heard she passed her baccalaureate!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Parabéns para a sua filha, fiquei sabendo que ela passou no exame de conclusão do ensino médio!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le syndic a dit qu'il remplacerait la porte d'entrée cet automne.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The building manager said he would replace the front door this autumn.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O síndico disse que ia trocar a porta de entrada neste outono.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous ai vu courir ce matin, vous vous entraînez pour une course ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I saw you running this morning, are you training for a race?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vi você correndo hoje de manhã, está treinando para alguma corrida?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ma femme a fait trop de confiture, vous en voulez un pot ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: My wife made too much jam, would you like a jar?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Minha esposa fez geleia demais, você quer um pote?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Est-ce que vous avez aussi eu des problèmes d'internet ce week-end ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you have internet problems this weekend too?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você também teve problemas com a internet neste fim de semana?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il y a eu un cambriolage au deuxième étage la semaine dernière.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There was a burglary on the second floor last week.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Teve um assalto a um apartamento do segundo andar na semana passada.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Nous partons quinze jours en Espagne, vous pourriez relever notre courrier ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: We're going to Spain for two weeks, could you collect our post?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vamos passar quinze dias na Espanha, você poderia pegar nossa correspondência?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça doit faire au moins vingt ans que je vis dans cet immeuble.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I must have been living in this building for at least twenty years.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Já devo morar neste prédio há pelo menos vinte anos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le parking sera fermé jeudi parce qu'on va refaire le marquage au sol.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The car park will be closed on Thursday because the lines are being repainted.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O estacionamento vai ficar fechado na quinta porque vão refazer a sinalização no chão.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez l'air fatigué ce soir, vous avez eu une longue journée ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: You look tired this evening, have you had a long day?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você parece cansado hoje à noite, teve um dia longo?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mes parents viennent ce week-end, ça vous dérange s'ils se garent ici ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: My parents are coming this weekend, do you mind if they park here?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meus pais vêm neste fim de semana, tem problema se eles estacionarem aqui?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chat est entré chez nous par la fenêtre de la cuisine.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your cat came into our place through the kitchen window.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu gato entrou na nossa casa pela janela da cozinha.

small talk with a neighbour.text: J'aimerais bien qu'on plante quelques arbres dans la cour de l'immeuble.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'd really like us to plant a few trees in the building's courtyard.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu gostaria que plantássemos algumas árvores no pátio do prédio.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez des nouvelles de madame Dubois depuis son opération ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you heard from Mrs Dubois since her operation?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você tem notícias da dona Dubois desde a cirurgia dela?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les poubelles jaunes seront ramassées le mercredi à partir du mois prochain.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The yellow bins will be collected on Wednesdays from next month.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As lixeiras amarelas vão ser recolhidas às quartas a partir do mês que vem.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il faisait si froid ce matin, vous avez réussi à démarrer votre voiture ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It was so cold this morning, did you manage to start your car?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Fazia tanto frio hoje de manhã, você conseguiu ligar o carro?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je ne savais pas que vous jouiez du violon, c'est très beau.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I didn't know you played the violin, it's very beautiful.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu não sabia que você tocava violino, é muito bonito.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça vous dirait de venir prendre l'apéritif chez nous vendredi ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Would you like to come round for drinks at our place on Friday?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que tal vir tomar um aperitivo lá em casa na sexta?

small talk with a neighbour.text: On m'a dit que vous alliez bientôt devenir grand-mère, c'est merveilleux !
small talk with a neighbour.en: I was told you're going to be a grandmother soon, that's wonderful!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Me contaram que a senhora vai ser avó em breve, que maravilha!

phone calls and appointments.text: Bonjour, je voudrais prendre rendez-vous avec le docteur Leroy, s'il vous plaît.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Leroy, please.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Bom dia, eu queria marcar uma consulta com o doutor Leroy, por favor.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce que je pourrais parler à madame Garnier, de la part de Julien ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could I speak to Mrs Garnier, it's Julien calling?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu poderia falar com a senhora Garnier, da parte do Julien?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous rappelle dans dix minutes, je suis dans le train.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you back in ten minutes, I'm on the train.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te ligo de volta em dez minutos, estou no trem.

phone calls and appointments.text: Désolé d'avoir raté votre appel, j'étais en réunion tout l'après-midi.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry I missed your call, I was in a meeting all afternoon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe por perder sua ligação, eu estava em reunião a tarde toda.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous pourriez me rappeler au numéro qui s'affiche ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you call me back on the number that's showing?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia me ligar de volta no número que aparece aí?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je dois annuler mon rendez-vous de jeudi, je suis malade.
phone calls and appointments.en: I have to cancel my appointment on Thursday, I'm ill.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Preciso cancelar minha consulta de quinta, estou doente.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ne quittez pas, je vous passe le service client.
phone calls and appointments.en: Please hold, I'll put you through to customer service.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Aguarde na linha, vou transferir para o atendimento ao cliente.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce qu'il vous reste des créneaux disponibles en fin de semaine ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you have any slots left at the end of the week?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vocês ainda têm horários disponíveis no fim da semana?

phone calls and appointments.text: La ligne était tellement mauvaise que je n'entendais rien.
phone calls and appointments.en: The line was so bad that I couldn't hear anything.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A ligação estava tão ruim que eu não ouvia nada.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous appelle au sujet de la facture que j'ai reçue hier.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling you about the bill I received yesterday.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando por causa da fatura que recebi ontem.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pourriez-vous lui dire que j'ai appelé et que je rappellerai demain ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you tell her that I called and that I'll call back tomorrow?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia dizer a ela que liguei e que ligo de novo amanhã?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon rendez-vous chez le coiffeur a été déplacé à samedi matin.
phone calls and appointments.en: My hairdresser's appointment has been moved to Saturday morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu horário no cabeleireiro foi remarcado para sábado de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si je n'avais pas oublié mon téléphone, je t'aurais prévenu.
phone calls and appointments.en: If I hadn't forgotten my phone, I would have let you know.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se eu não tivesse esquecido o celular, teria te avisado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous êtes bien sur le répondeur de Claire, laissez-moi un message.
phone calls and appointments.en: You've reached Claire's voicemail, leave me a message.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você ligou para a caixa postal da Claire, deixe sua mensagem.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce que mardi à quatorze heures vous conviendrait ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Would Tuesday at two p.m. suit you?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Terça às catorze horas seria bom para você?

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai essayé de vous joindre plusieurs fois, mais ça sonnait occupé.
phone calls and appointments.en: I tried to reach you several times, but the line was busy.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tentei falar com você várias vezes, mas só dava ocupado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je confirmerai le rendez-vous par courriel dès que possible.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll confirm the appointment by email as soon as possible.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou confirmar o horário por e-mail assim que possível.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pouvez-vous épeler votre nom de famille, s'il vous plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can you spell your surname, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você pode soletrar seu sobrenome, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Ma batterie est presque vide, je risque d'être coupé.
phone calls and appointments.en: My battery is almost dead, I might get cut off.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha bateria está quase acabando, a ligação pode cair.

phone calls and appointments.text: On avait rendez-vous à midi, mais il est arrivé avec une heure de retard.
phone calls and appointments.en: We were meeting at noon, but he arrived an hour late.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A gente tinha marcado ao meio-dia, mas ele chegou com uma hora de atraso.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je préférerais un rendez-vous en début de matinée, avant le travail.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd prefer an appointment early in the morning, before work.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu preferiria um horário logo cedo, antes do trabalho.

phone calls and appointments.text: Excusez-moi, je crois que j'ai fait un mauvais numéro.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I think I've dialled the wrong number.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, acho que liguei para o número errado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le garage m'a appelé pour me dire que la voiture était prête.
phone calls and appointments.en: The garage called me to say the car was ready.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A oficina me ligou para dizer que o carro estava pronto.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce que vous pourriez m'envoyer un rappel la veille du rendez-vous ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you send me a reminder the day before the appointment?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia me mandar um lembrete na véspera da consulta?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je n'arrive pas à trouver le numéro de la mairie sur internet.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can't find the town hall's number online.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não consigo achar o telefone da prefeitura na internet.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ça fait vingt minutes que j'attends en ligne avec cette musique horrible.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've been on hold for twenty minutes with this awful music.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Faz vinte minutos que estou esperando na linha com essa música horrível.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vais noter le rendez-vous dans mon agenda pour ne pas oublier.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll write the appointment in my diary so I don't forget.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou anotar o compromisso na agenda para não esquecer.

phone calls and appointments.text: Avant, j'appelais ma mère tous les soirs pour lui raconter ma journée.
phone calls and appointments.en: I used to call my mother every evening to tell her about my day.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Antes, eu ligava para minha mãe toda noite para contar como tinha sido meu dia.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pourriez-vous parler un peu plus lentement, je ne comprends pas tout ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you speak a little more slowly, I don't understand everything?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia falar um pouco mais devagar? Não estou entendendo tudo.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le rendez-vous chez le notaire est fixé au 12 mars à dix heures.
phone calls and appointments.en: The appointment with the notary is set for 12 March at ten o'clock.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O horário no cartório está marcado para 12 de março às dez horas.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je suis désolée, monsieur Roux est absent jusqu'à lundi.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm sorry, Mr Roux is away until Monday.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sinto muito, o senhor Roux está ausente até segunda.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si vous ne pouvez pas venir, merci de nous prévenir vingt-quatre heures à l'avance.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you can't come, please let us know twenty-four hours in advance.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se não puder vir, por favor nos avise com vinte e quatro horas de antecedência.

phone calls and appointments.text: Tu m'appelles quand tu arrives à la gare, d'accord ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Call me when you get to the station, okay?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me liga quando chegar à estação, combinado?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous mets en attente quelques secondes, le temps de vérifier.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll put you on hold for a few seconds while I check.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou colocar você em espera por alguns segundos enquanto verifico.

phone calls and appointments.text: Elle a pris rendez-vous en ligne parce que le standard était toujours occupé.
phone calls and appointments.en: She booked an appointment online because the switchboard was always busy.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ela marcou horário pela internet porque a central estava sempre ocupada.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce que je dois apporter des documents particuliers pour le rendez-vous ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do I need to bring any particular documents to the appointment?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Preciso levar algum documento específico para a consulta?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je laisserai un message à la secrétaire si personne ne répond.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll leave a message with the secretary if nobody answers.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou deixar um recado com a secretária se ninguém atender.

phone calls and appointments.text: Nous avons fixé une réunion par téléphone avec le fournisseur demain matin.
phone calls and appointments.en: We've set up a phone meeting with the supplier tomorrow morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Marcamos uma reunião por telefone com o fornecedor amanhã de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Tu pourrais me donner le numéro de ton plombier, s'il te plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you give me your plumber's number, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia me passar o telefone do seu encanador, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Le rendez-vous a duré moins de dix minutes, c'était très rapide.
phone calls and appointments.en: The appointment lasted less than ten minutes, it was very quick.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A consulta durou menos de dez minutos, foi muito rápida.
